description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler component in an Android application, including test cases for permission handling, location fetching with different accuracy and timeout scenarios, and verification of permission status functions.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the LocationHandler component, verifying permission checks, location retrieval behavior under different conditions, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of LocationDataSource used in unit tests to simulate location permission states, location fetch responses, failures, and timeouts.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Test that requesting location without fine or coarse permissions results in a permission required error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Test that background location requests are blocked when foreground permission isn't granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Verify that the permission status functions accurately reflect the data source states.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Test that with fine permission and 'precise' enabled, GPS provider is prioritized with correct parameters.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Verify fallback to less precise providers when 'precise' is unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Verify that a timeout in location fetching maps correctly to a timeout error result.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Ensure other failures (exceptions) in location fetching map to a location unavailable error.
